members.name: Joe Mansueto
members.role: chairman of the Board and executive chairman of the Company
members.quote: Joe Mansueto served as chairman of the board and chief executive officer of the Company until January 1, 2017. At that time, Joe stepped back from our day-to-day operations to instead focus on strategy, capital allocation, advising our senior team, and leading the Board. Joe serves as chairman of the Board and executive chairman of the Company.

members.name: Kunal Kapoor
members.quote: Kunal Kapoor has served as chief executive officer and a Board member since January 1, 2017.

members.name: Robin Diamonte
members.quote: Robin Diamonte was appointed to the Board in December 2015. She is the chief investment officer of Raytheon Technologies Corp.

members.name: Cheryl Francis
members.quote: Cheryl Francis was elected to the Board in July 2002. She has been co-chair of Corporate Leadership Center, a not-for-profit organization focused on developing tomorrow’s business leaders, since August 2008

members.name: Steve Joynt
members.quote: Steve Joynt was appointed to the Board in December 2019. He served as chief executive officer of DBRS, the global credit ratings agency acquired by Morningstar in July 2019

members.name: Steve Kaplan
members.quote: Steve Kaplan served as a member of our advisory board beginning in 1998 and was elected to the Board in August 1999.

members.name: Gail Landis
members.quote: Gail Landis was elected to the Board in May 2013. She was a founding partner of Evercore Asset Management, LLC, an institutional asset management firm

members.name: Bill Lyons
members.role: Chair of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee
members.quote: Bill Lyons was appointed to the Board in September 2007. He served as president and chief executive officer of American Century Companies, Inc., an investment management company, from September 2000 until his retirement in March 2007.

members.name: Doniel Sutton
members.quote: Doniel Sutton was appointed to the board in May 2021. She has served as chief people officer of Fastly, Inc., a leading global provider of edge cloud platform services, since September 2020.

members.name: Caroline Tsay
members.quote: Caroline Tsay was elected to the Board in May 2017. She has served as chief executive officer of Compute Software, Inc., an enterprise cloud infrastructure software company, since January 2017.
